announcements.title: Welcome to PRISM Labs!
announcements.content: Welcome to Term 3! We're excited to have you join PRISM Labs. This term we're covering AI literacy, ethics, and building real projects. Check out Week 4 resources and see you Thursday at 10:45 AM in Room 7!
announcements.author: Mr. Vinzon

announcements.title: Bring Your Ideas!
announcements.content: Do you have an idea for a project? Maybe an app that would help students, a tool for teachers, or something completely new? Start thinking about it — we'll be pitching projects in Week 9. The best ideas can become real tools for our school!
announcements.author: Mr. Vinzon

announcements.title: Permission Forms Due
announcements.content: If you haven't already, please bring your signed permission form to the next session. Forms were sent home with your registration confirmation. Without a signed form, we can't let you participate in club activities.
announcements.author: Mr. Vinzon
